Building repairs / GOLD COAST

Tracking water ingress in commercial buildings

How we connect the reported stain with the building areas that need investigation.

Ellis Services Group · Maintenance notes

We start with the location, timing and pattern of the reported water ingress. We ask which rooms or surfaces are affected, whether the issue appears with rain or equipment use, and what repairs have already been attempted. Photos and a short history help us plan the inspection.

We inspect the accessible building elements relevant to the symptoms, which may include roofing, flashings, balcony details, external joints or plumbing. We define any testing or opening-up separately before proceeding. We use the findings to explain the repair location, method and extent.

We record the treated areas and the conditions under which the problem was observed. Where follow-up observation is part of the work, we set that out in the handover. Gold Coast rainfall varies across the year, so we connect any post-repair checks to the reported conditions and keep the observations with the property's maintenance record.

  • www.goldcoast.qld.gov.au
